milestone: M45 External Mode Pack Registry Trust Policy

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes registry update selection require trusted signed registry manifest provenance before selection persistence.
Keeps registry publisher trust admission in the Rust runtime and fails closed before selection ledger mutation.
Persists only bounded registry trust evidence on existing selection evidence: statement SHA-256, signer fingerprint, and trusted signer ids.
Lets unattended registry update flows deterministically decide whether a registry-selected candidate came from a currently trusted registry publisher.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances mode_pack_runtime directly, with supporting progress for runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: modepack.selectRegistryUpdate now requires trusted signed registry manifest provenance evidence before persisting registry update selection evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M44 and R5 verify registry hash, DNS binding, and later active candidate identity, but they do not verify registry publisher trust before selection mutation.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless registry update flows would still rely on caller-provided manifest hashes rather than runtime-owned registry publisher trust.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M43 verifies candidate signer trust for active updates, M44 selects from a registry manifest, R5.1 pins fetch DNS, and R5.2 binds activation identity; M45.1 verifies the registry manifest publisher before selection.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing modepack.selectRegistryUpdate path changes behavior; no method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Bounded registry trust evidence is added to the existing registry selection summary rather than adding a report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, or preview surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime rejects missing, malformed, mismatched, revoked, expired, or unverifiable registry trust evidence before registry selection persistence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can continue update discovery only when the runtime proves the registry manifest was signed by a currently trusted signer and bound to the fetched manifest/candidate tuple.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the core M45 registry trust boundary by making registry publisher trust runtime-owned before selection.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M45.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M45.1 value gate. Review must confirm this is registry manifest trust admission enforcement, not a registry trust report wrapper.

exit_criteria: modepack.selectRegistryUpdate requires explicit registry trust authorization and signed registry manifest provenance materials

registry trust verification binds registry URL fingerprint, DNS binding fingerprints, manifest hash, active modepack identity, selected candidate URL/content/policy/provenance fields, and signer fingerprint
selection fails before ledger mutation when trust evidence is missing, malformed, mismatched, revoked, expired, or unverifiable
successful selection returns and persists only bounded registry trust evidence on existing selection surfaces
existing DNS pinning, candidate identity, manifest hash, unsafe URL, replay, and raw-data exclusion invariants remain intact
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, generic network executor, or automatic update path is added
